task.title: 审查 All Settings 注意项
task.shortdesc: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：审查 All Settings 注意项. Use Review mode to triage invalid, CIS manual-review, raw, unknown, deprecated, and imported items before routine editing.

prereq.p: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：审查 All Settings 注意项. Open a saved profile in All Settings.

context.p: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：审查 All Settings 注意项. Review mode is the default attention-first view. It gathers settings that may require a decision before export, comparison, or handoff.

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：审查 All Settings 注意项. Open All Settings and stay in Review mode.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：审查 All Settings 注意项. Read the review summary and grouped action cards.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：审查 All Settings 注意项. Open each invalid, CIS manual-review, raw, unknown, deprecated, or imported item that applies to the profile.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：审查 All Settings 注意项. Resolve the item, document why it remains, or move to the linked detail view for a deliberate edit.

info.note: 警告：保存前请检查架构、值来源以及更改后果。

result.p: All Settings 显示配置文件的预期状态，并且该操作可在审查时解释。 Attention items are either resolved, intentionally retained, or ready for a focused detail edit.

postreq.p: 恢复：如果结果不符合预期，请清除筛选器、返回详细信息面板或打开相关主题。 Recovery: if Review looks empty but you expected issues, clear filters, refresh the profile, and confirm the selected schema channel.
